Specification: This module specifies a very small PlusCal algorithm that repeatedly increments a numeric variable x and toggles a Boolean variable y inside an infinite while loop. The translated TLA+ initialization sets x to 1 and y to FALSE, and the single action Next updates x to x + 1, flips y using negation, and checks an assertion that the new value of x remains less than 5. The temporal specification is simply Init /\ [][Next]_vars, so it models all behaviors consisting of the initial state followed by repeated Next or stuttering steps, with no explicit fairness conditions or separate liveness properties.
FunctionApplication: Assert(x' < 5, "Failure of assertion at line 11, column 9.")
StringLiterals: Failure of assertion at line 11, column 9.
